items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat vier ballistische Raketen und 115 Drohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen die russischen Besatzer seit Dienstagabend, dem 13. Oktober, das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hatten.

items.title: Russians attack all three combined heat and power plants in Kyiv
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has confirmed Russian ballistic missiles hit all three combined heat and power plants in Kyiv, alongside critical power facilities across Kyiv Oblast.

items.title: Partners warn Ukraine of ballistic missile threat during three waves of Russian attacks – military spox
items.teaser: Ukraine received no warning from its partners about the use of ballistic missiles during the first wave of Russia’s attack, but warnings were issued during the next three waves.

items.title: Three more villages and 101 sq km: Ukrainian commander Biletskyi reports new gains in Operation Vivaldi
items.teaser: Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps has liberated Zelena Dolyna, Lypove and Kolodiazi and regained 101 sq km during the fourth stage of Operation Vivaldi.

items.title: Ukraine outlines extent of damage from massive Russian attack on energy sector
items.teaser: Ukrenergo has initiated emergency repairs and hourly power restrictions in Kyiv and eight oblasts as a result of Russian strikes on electricity infrastructure.

items.title: SpaceX imposes unannounced speed limit on Starlink terminals used by Ukraine’s Defense Forces
items.teaser: Serhii “Flash” Beskrestnov, a freelance adviser to the President of Ukraine on technology, said SpaceX imposed speed restrictions on Starlink terminals in motion overnight without notifying Ukraine’s Defense Forces.

items.title: Russia built new Millerovo drone base for Geran-5 UAVs in one month – satellite images
items.teaser: Satellite images show Russia has built a new drone base in Millerovo in just one month, including launch positions for Geran-5 drones and facilities to prepare UAVs for launch.

items.title: 'This cannot be a coincidence' — Ukraine's Starlink access restricted without warning, Zelensky adviser says
items.teaser: Ukraine relies on Starlink to operate its mid-strike drones in Russian-occupied Ukraine.

items.title: Allies warned Ukraine of three ballistic waves, but not the first – Air Force
items.teaser: Yurii Ihnat has explained when intelligence about Russia's massive 39-missile attack reached Ukraine, noting that partners provided warnings ahead of the three subsequent waves.

items.title: Russia-linked bot networks kept their weekly rhythm after drone strikes on three Yandex data centers—disinformation monitor LetsData
items.teaser: One network that spread fake Die Welt sites now pushes a fake Ukrinform site about mobilization in Ukraine, its analysts found.

items.title: Papst Leo XIV. wegen Lungenkrebs operiert - News kompakt: Das Wichtigste kurz gefasst
items.teaser: Die Operation verlief nach Angaben der Ärzte ohne Komplikationen. Bei einem russischen Raketenangriff auf Kyjiw wurden mindestens zwei Menschen getötet und ein Heizkraftwerk getroffen. Der DW-Nachrichtenüberblick.

items.title: SpaceX restricts Starlink for Ukrainian military, disrupting combat missions
items.teaser: SpaceX has restricted Starlink terminals operating in motion, disrupting Ukrainian combat missions. The limit was later reportedly tightened to 60-70 km/h.

items.title: 'Ostentatious disrespect' — Zelensky says Russia defied Trump's energy ceasefire with latest missile strike
items.teaser: "The strike was entirely deliberate and demonstrative in its scale," President Volodymyr Zelensky said, adding that "Russia does not consider the American President's statements strong."

items.title: Ukraine downs four ballistic missiles, 115 drones in massive Russian overnight attack
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized four ballistic missiles and 115 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country starting in the evening of October 13.

items.title: Russians attack railway stations, depots and carriages overnight
items.teaser: Ukrzaliznytsia head Oleksandr Pertsovskyi has confirmed massive overnight Russian strikes on railway facilities, with power restored and alternative routes organised.

items.title: Russische Raketen treffen Wohnhaus und Kraftwerk in Kiew
items.teaser: Bei russischen Raketenangriffen auf Kiew sind ein Wohnhaus und ein Heizkraftwerk getroffen worden. Präsident Selenskyj beklagte die fehlenden Warnungen durch Verbündete.

items.title: Russian drone debris sparks fire at gas station in Khmelnytskyi region, two injured
items.teaser: A gas station caught fire after debris from a Russian drone fell in the Khmelnytskyi district, Khmelnytskyi region, injuring two people.

items.title: Russian forces attack oil depot in Lutsk overnight, sparking fire
items.teaser: A Russian drone hit an oil depot in Lutsk overnight, starting a large fire at around 02:00. Firefighters extinguished the blaze at 04:38.

items.title: Prozess beginnt heute: "Wer hinter dem Nord-Stream-Anschlag steckt, ist ziemlich klar"
items.teaser: Wer hat die Nord-Stream-Pipelines gesprengt? Der Investigativjournalist Oliver Schröm hat mit mutmaßlichen Drahtziehern gesprochen. Zum Auftakt des Prozesses gegen den Ukrainer Serhii K. in Hamburg erklärt Schröm, warum er Präsident Selenskyj nicht für verantwortlich hält.

items.title: Zelenskyy on overnight attack: Russia has never shown such disrespect for America
items.teaser: Russia launched 39 ballistic missiles and more than 120 attack drones and drone missiles on Ukraine's energy and critical infrastructure facilities overnight, leaving at least 600,000 people without electricity. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called on Washington to respond firmly and provide more Patriot intercepto

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,557,350 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,650 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Ukrainian forces report restrictions on military Starlink service
items.teaser: High-speed Ukrainian drone operations have encountered connectivity cutoffs after SpaceX imposed a 100 mph speed limit on military Starshield terminals.

items.title: Russian combined attack on Kyiv kills four, Injures 27
items.teaser: Four people were killed and 27 injured in a combined Russian attack on Kyiv on October 14, including a seven-year-old child, according to the latest reports.

items.title: 'Blown out of proportion' — Domestic politics at the core of South Korea's rift with Ukraine
items.teaser: Seoul's diplomatic spat with Kyiv continues to deepen, but experts say it is less about Ukraine than about South Korea's own politics. The East Asian country, traditionally counted among Ukraine 's partners in the region, announced on Oct. 8 that it is recalling its ambassador

items.title: Russia launches massive ballistic missile strike on energy grid: air defence brings down 4 out of 39 missiles and 115 drones
items.teaser: Russian forces have targeted energy infrastructure across Kyiv and Kharkiv with 39 ballistic missiles and jet drones, hitting 26 energy assets.

items.title: Prozess gegen Ukrainer Serhij K. beginnt in Hamburg
items.teaser: Rund vier Jahre nach den Anschlägen auf die Nord-Stream-Pipelines in der Ostsee muss sich erstmals einer der mutmaßlichen Täter vor Gericht verantworten. FOCUS online ist vor Ort.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1650 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 14. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.557.350 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 1650 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: UK to speed up delivery of missiles to counter jet-powered drones in Ukraine
items.teaser: The UK will accelerate the delivery of its Lightweight Multirole Missiles (LMMs) to Ukraine, bringing forward £10 million worth of weapons to meet urgent needs ahead of winter. The move comes as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy prepares to visit the UK.

items.title: Lange Haftstrafe droht: OpenAI-Mitarbeiter wird wegen verstecktem Abhörgerät festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Angst vor Spionage geht unter KI-Firmen angesichts des globalen Wettrüstens verstärkt um. In einem aktuellen Fall bei dem ChatGPT-Entwickler OpenAI versucht ein 35-jähriger Mitarbeiter einen Konferenzraum abzuhören. Doch die Aktion fliegt auf.

items.title: War update: 229 clashes along front line over past day, Pokrovsk sector sees fiercest fighting
items.teaser: A total of 229 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on October 13.

items.title: UP's Tkach: Kravchenko associates may be behind Vienna detention tip-off
items.teaser: Head of UP's investigative journalism team, Mykhailo Tkach, believes witnesses who alleged espionage to Austrian authorities were tied to former prosecutor general Ruslan Kravchenko.

items.title: Kombinierter Angriff auf Kyjiw: Drei Todesopfer, 27 Verletzte
items.teaser: In Kyjiw kamen am 14. Oktober infolge eines kombinierten russischen Angriffs drei Menschen ums Leben.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,650 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, reached approximately 1,557,350 personnel as of October 14, 2026, including 1,650 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Prozess-Auftakt Nord-Stream-Sabotage - BILD exklusiv an Bord der Sprengstoff-Jacht
items.teaser: Vier Jahre nach den Explosionen an den Nord-Stream-Pipelines beginnt in Hamburg der Prozess gegen den Ukrainer Serhii K. Die Bundesa...

items.title: Former Ukrainian president Yushchenko writes open letter to Trump
items.teaser: Viktor Yushchenko has criticised Donald Trump's agreement with Vladimir Putin to allow Russian diesel fuel onto US and global markets. The former Ukrainian president says the trade helps fund Russia's war and reminds Washington of its commitments under the 1994 Budapest Memorandum.

items.title: MI5 Chief calls Russia UK’s No. 1 aggressor
items.teaser: The UK Security Service MI5 continues to regard Russia as the greatest threat to the United Kingdom.

items.title: "Betrayal of the people of Ukraine": 12 US senators write to Trump over deal with Putin
items.teaser: Twelve Democratic and Republican senators have called on Donald Trump to reverse an agreement with Vladimir Putin allowing Russian-origin diesel to reach global markets. They say the deal undermines US security and betrays Ukraine, and urge the president to enforce sanctions authorised by Congress.

items.title: Germany joins Ukraine Transport Support Fund with EUR 1M contribution
items.teaser: Germany has joined the Ukraine Transport Support Fund with a contribution of €1 million.

items.title: Strikes on Russian data centers could be as disruptive as attacks on oil refineries, expert says
items.teaser: In the long term, strikes on Russian data centers could prove no less damaging to the aggressor’s economy than attacks on oil refineries.

items.title: 11KM-Podcast: Nord-Stream-Anschlag im Auftrag der Ukraine?
items.teaser: Im Nord-Stream-Prozess steht der mutmaßliche Anführer des Sabotageteams vor Gericht. 11KM erklärt, warum die Bundesanwaltschaft davon ausgeht, dass der Angeklagte im Auftrag staatlicher Stellen der Ukraine gehandelt hat.

items.title: Three killed in Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv overnight – photo
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with missiles and drones overnight, killing three people. Rescue workers are clearing the aftermath in several districts, with at least 21 people injured and 16 residents rescued from a damaged apartment block.

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfen: Wie der Nord-Stream-Prozess die Stimmung verändern könnte
items.teaser: Heute beginnt in Hamburg der Nord-Stream-Prozess. Angeklagt ist ein Ukrainer. Juristisch geht es um die Verantwortung für die Sabotage. Politisch dürfte der Prozess die Debatte über die Ukraine-Hilfen befeuern. Von C. Nagel.

items.title: Russian ballistic missile strike causes power cuts in Kyiv
items.teaser: Kyiv is experiencing emergency power cuts after Russian forces launched a large-scale ballistic missile attack on energy facilities in the capital and surrounding area. Rolling power outage schedules have been temporarily suspended in several districts.

items.title: Russian forces strike Epicentr’s logistics hub in Khmelnytskyi 10 times in one day
items.teaser: A major logistics distribution center of Ukrainian retail chain Epicentr in Khmelnytskyi was destroyed in a series of Russian drone attacks.

items.title: Zelensky, Carney discuss U.S. contacts and upcoming diplomatic events
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke by phone with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.

items.title: Forum 2000 participants to join Global Crimea International Conference in Kyiv
items.teaser: The Forum 2000 discussion platform is supporting the Fourth Global Crimea International Conference, titled “Global Crimea: Understanding Ukraine Through the Global South,” scheduled to take place in Kyiv on October 19.

items.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv energy facilities kill one and disrupt some transport services
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked several energy facilities in Kyiv overnight. Electric transport was suspended in two districts, while Kyiv City Express train services were halted in both directions amid heightened aerial threat.

items.title: Fire breaks out near Russian metallurgical plant after reported drone attack
items.teaser: Footage shows an explosion and subsequent fire after a reported drone strike near a large metallurgical plant in Balakovo, located in the Saratov region, according to reports by the Exilenova+ Telegram channel.

items.title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills two, injures 21
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight, killing two people and injuring 21, including an eight-year-old child.

items.title: Selenskyj beklagt fehlende Warnung vor russischen Angriffen
items.teaser: Eine russische Rakete hat nach Angaben des ukrainischen Präsidenten Selenskyj ein Heizkraftwerk in Kiew getroffen. Wie er mitteilte, hatten die westlichen Verbündeten die Ukraine zuvor nicht vor dem Angriff gewarnt.

items.title: Nord-Stream-Anschlag - Prozess startet in Hamburg
items.teaser: Rund vier Jahre nach den Explosionen an Nord Stream beginnt in Hamburg der Prozess gegen Serhij K.

items.title: Sondersitzung im Landtag zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: In Sachsen-Anhalt kommt heute der Landtag zu einer Sondersitzung zusammen. Auf der Tagesordnung steht ein Antrag von AfD und BSW: Sie fordern, die Waffenlieferungen an die Ukraine und die Russland-Sanktionen zu stoppen.

items.title: Russia prepares for possible direct military confrontation with Europe by 2045, Ukrainian Intelligence says
items.teaser: Russia is preparing for the possibility of a direct military confrontation with Europe by 2045, according to Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service. Northern Europe could be among the regions at risk.

items.title: Russian jet-powered drone strikes office building in Ternopil
items.teaser: A Russian jet-powered drone struck an office building in Ternopil at 23:44 on 13 October. Authorities are establishing whether anyone was injured and have urged the public not to share images or details of the impact site.

items.title: Pletenchuk: Russian naval drones pose threat to Black Sea countries
items.teaser: Russia could use aerial and naval drones to carry out attacks in the Black Sea, while the hybrid component of such operations involves information campaigns accompanying them.

items.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on espionage charges
items.teaser: Russia's Security Service (FSB) said that a Japanese citizen working for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper was arrested in the country's far east near islands disputed by Russia and Japan before being taken to Moscow.

items.title: Zelenskyy speaks to Canadian PM about Russian strike on Kyiv and upcoming engagement with US
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has spoken to Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney about an overnight Russian attack on Kyiv, the lack of advance warning from partners about ballistic missile launches and planned diplomatic contact with the US.

items.title: Donetsk region to introduce extended curfew starting November 1
items.teaser: Starting November 1, a curfew from 16:00 to 11:00 will be imposed in Kramatorsk and throughout the Ukrainian-controlled territory of Donetsk region, with the exception of two communities.

items.title: EU treibt Beitritt von Ukraine und Moldau voran
items.teaser: Die Europäische Union weitet die Beitrittsverhandlungen mit der Ukraine und Moldau aus. Bis zu einem EU-Beitritt der Ukraine dürfte es allerdings noch Jahre dauern.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russia destroys Epicentr's last major logistics centre in Khmelnytskyi – photo
items.teaser: Epicentr says Russian forces hit its distribution hub ten times on 13 October, triggering five fires. The facility was its last surviving major logistics complex after earlier strikes destroyed two others in and around Kyiv.

items.title: Russian strike on Kyiv kills two and injures 21, including child
items.teaser: Emergency services are responding to a fire and damage at a residential building in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district. Sixteen people injured have been taken to hospital, with four in a serious condition.

items.title: Ukraine’s tanks are back! But only because drones are escorting them.
items.teaser: Armored vehicles aren't dead on arrival anymore on the drone-patrolled battlefield. Friendly drones can escort them to the fight.

items.title: Spox Trehubov: Russian forces may seek to expand control zone along Kharkiv region border
items.teaser: Russian troops may step up their activities in the Velykyi Burluk sector of the Kharkiv region, specifically attempting to advance toward the village of Anyshchyne and expand their zone of control along the state border.

items.title: Another oil storage tank explodes at refinery terminal near Rostov – video
items.teaser: Footage shared by monitoring Telegram channels shows flames rising above the oil loading terminal near Rostov after an explosion on 13 October. The facility had been attacked on 10 October.

items.title: Hamburg - Prozess um Anschläge auf Nord-Stream-Pipeline beginnt
items.teaser: Rund vier Jahre nach den Anschlägen auf die Nord-Stream-Pipelines beginnt heute der Prozess gegen einen der mutmaßlichen Täter.

items.title: Participants in Bari discuss Ukrainian community safety and new cultural initiatives
items.teaser: During a working visit to the Italian city of Bari, Larysa Polishchuk, Consul General in Naples, discussed the safety of Ukrainians, support for Ukraine, and cooperation with the local community with local officials.

items.title: Ukraine’s 3rd Army Corps took the lessons of the failed 2023 counteroffensive into Operation Vivaldi. It fought small, and won.
items.teaser: Five months in, it has erased 18 months of Russian advances toward Sloviansk.

items.title: Attentatspläne gegen Tusk : Verdächtiger hatte Sprengsätze im Haus
items.teaser: Am Sonntag nimmt die Polizei in Polen einen Mann fest, der Anschläge auf Präsident Tusk und den Verteidigungsminister geplant haben soll. Der 66-Jährige schweigt zu den Vorwürfen. In seiner Wohnung findet sich belastendes Material.

items.title: Attentatspläne gegen Tusk : Verdächtiger in Polen hatte Sprengsätze im Haus
items.teaser: Am Sonntag nimmt die Polizei in Polen einen Mann fest, der Anschläge auf Präsident Tusk und den Verteidigungsminister geplant haben soll. Der 66-Jährige schweigt zu den Vorwürfen. In seiner Wohnung findet sich belastendes Material.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1693: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv before air raid sirens, as fears grow that the US could cut launch warning data
items.teaser: With Washington reportedly tying its intelligence and arms to Kyiv sparing Russian refineries, Ukraine’s largest steelworks began shutting down after Russian strikes, and Ukraine answered abroad by winning a seat on the UN Human Rights Council.

items.title: Russia has struck Kyiv energy infrastructure with ballistic missiles, Ukraine received no warning from partners – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Russia’s ballistic missile attack damaged Kyiv’s CHPP-4 and a residential building on 13 October. Zelenskyy says Ukraine’s systems detected the missiles only as they approached the capital.

items.title: Russian strike on university in Rivne injures 30 as cleanup operations conclude
items.teaser: In Rivne, the aftermath of a Russian attack on an educational institution has been cleared up, including the removal of debris and collapsed structures. Currently, 30 people are known to have been injured.

items.title: Ukrainian scouts used a captured Russian soldier’s radio to gather intelligence for four days
items.teaser: Recon soldiers shared stories about their daily lives with ArmyInform.
